---
title: "Slingshot analysis of ferret pancreatic dataset, after integration with human dataset"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
author: "Chris Hill"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(biomaRt)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(grid)
library(here)
library(JASPAR2020)
library(scAnalysisR)
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(TFBSTools)
library(tradeSeq)

source(here("src/common_setup.R"))
source(here("src/07_ferret_lineages_helpers.R"))
ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10))
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")

# Load in the final Seurat object
ferret_subset <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "05_final_ferret.rds"))
```

```{r "Get analysis plots", fig.width=10,fig.height=4, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# Subset the ductal clusters from the combined object
ductal_clusters <- c(9, 0, 5, 12, 17)
cluster_subset <- subset(ferret_subset,
  subset = seurat_clusters %in% ductal_clusters
)

# Convert to single cell experiment
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(cluster_subset)

# Extract only the top 15 PCs for slingshot object
pca_subset <- reducedDim(sce, "PCA")[, 1:15]
```

# Ductal Lineage {.tabset}
```{r "Ferret new pseudotime S9E0", fig.width=12,fig.height=7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load in fitgam calculations
fitgam_sce <- readRDS(here(file.path(
  fitgam_dir,
  "fitgam_ferret_ductal_S9E0.rda"
)))

# Calculate lineage associations from query genes
query_names <- get_query_names(cluster_subset, cluster_number = 9)
lineage_assocRes <- associationTest(fitgam_sce, lineages = TRUE)

# Get the slingshot curves from the subset Seurat object
curves <- get_curves(
  seurat_object = cluster_subset,
  sce = sce,
  reduced_dim = pca_subset,
  reduction = "umap",
  start_cluster = 9,
  end_cluster = 0
)
```

## S9E0 L3
```{r "lineage_plot L3 S9E0", fig.width=12,fig.height=5, echo = FALSE}
# Calculate lineage 3 for the ductal slingshot curves
lineage_plot <- getplots(
  sce = sce,
  slingshot_sce = curves$slingshot_sce,
  all_curves = curves$all_curves,
  seurat_object = ferret_subset,
  slingshot_seurat = cluster_subset,
  dimension = "umap",
  lineage = 3
)

# Print slingshot lineage plot
print(lineage_plot)
```

```{r "ductal lineage 3 plotting S9E0 heatmap", fig.width=10,fig.height=12, echo = FALSE}
# Create lineage heatmaps
plots <- make_lineage_heatmaps(
  slingshot_sce = curves$slingshot_sce,
  gene_list = query_names,
  object = cluster_subset,
  lineage = 3,
  lineage_asso_res = lineage_assocRes,
  waldcutoff = 200,
  pval_cutoff = 0.05,
  save_dir = image_dir,
  fraction = 150
)

# Print significant genes heatmap
print(plots$heatmap)
```

# Acinar Lineage {.tabset}

```{r "Get analysis plots acinar", fig.width=10,fig.height=4, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# Subset to acinar clusters only in combined dataset
acinar_clusters <- c(9, 4, 14, 1, 16, 8, 11, 10)
cluster_subset <- subset(ferret_subset,
  subset = seurat_clusters %in% acinar_clusters
)

# Convert to single cell experiment
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(cluster_subset)

# Extract only the top 15 PCs for slingshot object
pca_subset <- reducedDim(sce, "PCA")[, 1:15]
```

```{r "acinar S9E10 pseudotime", fig.width=12,fig.height=7, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load in fitgam calculations
fitgam_sce <- readRDS(here(fitgam_dir, "fitgam_ferret_acinar_S9E10.rda"))

# Calculate lineage associations from query genes
query_names <- get_query_names(cluster_subset, cluster_number = 9)
lineage_assocRes <- associationTest(fitgam_sce, lineages = TRUE)

# Get the slingshot curves from the subset Seurat object
curves <- get_curves(
  seurat_object = cluster_subset,
  sce = sce,
  reduced_dim = pca_subset,
  reduction = "umap",
  start_cluster = 9,
  end_cluster = 10
)
```
